title: 花旗策略师：AI行情进入新阶段，从硬件到应用
speaker: Viata Mante

segments.en: Well, within tech, and I think we've seen the softening of large cap tech. But I think, so in terms of market leadership, so when you look at AI, people want to figure out which component of AI leads the rally moving forward.
segments.zh: 我们看到大型科技股有所走软。在AI领域，人们想知道哪个环节将引领下一阶段的上涨。

segments.en: So we've gone from hyperscalers, semis to hyperscalers, back to semis, and it's now the components, memory, do we get energy? So how do you look at that sort of more nuanced trade within the AI basket?
segments.zh: 从超大规模企业到半导体，再到组件、存储，甚至能源。您如何看待AI板块内部这种更细致的轮动？

segments.en: Absolutely, and that's the most difficult question, because the AI trade is ever, ever evolving. And we measure that in six, six waves of six phases of that AI trade already.
segments.zh: 这是最难的问题，因为AI行情一直在演变。我们已经将其划分为六个阶段。

segments.en: And of course, as we move away, or not completely move away, or take the weight off, right, of the memory, then we are thinking more about the adoption or the broader set of the regions actually feeding into that trade.
segments.zh: 当我们降低存储的权重时，我们更多考虑AI的应用，以及哪些地区会受益。

segments.en: So tech isn't overweight, communication services where hyperscalers are in underweight. And a few weeks ago within our emerging market portfolio, emerging markets in global portfolio are a neutral.
segments.zh: 科技板块并非超配，通信服务（超大规模企业所在）是低配。几周前，我们全球组合中的新兴市场配置为中性。

segments.en: But within that, a few weeks ago, we've swapped our long, like, one year overweight in Korea and swapped it with China actually. That's a sign of that broadening, right? Because when Korea was going up so much a day, there was really no space for anybody else.
segments.zh: 但几周前，我们将韩国的一年超配调整为对中国超配。这是市场广度扩大的信号，因为此前韩国涨幅过大，其他市场没有空间。
